ratings.reason: Prefix-level risk prediction from observable trajectory signals with key-step boundary labeling enables early-intervention monitoring of web agents without internal logits.

ToolGate's three-gate acceptance pipeline (executable FEniCSx solution scripts, randomized no-tool screening, timed agent solving) automates construction of verified tool-dependent scientific benchmarks.
Self-evolving memory framework with an attribute-before-memorize principle that attributes each outcome to plan, execution, both, or neither before updating hierarchical planning and execution banks.

Execution-driven web-development agent replays reference interaction trajectories and uses an execution-aware rendering score to validate interactive functionality, plus an execution-verified data synthesis pipeline.

Clusters positive and negative activations per attention head and solves an optimal-matching problem for input-conditional steering directions, evidencing that concepts span multiple activation sub-regions.
Spectral framework locates edit-sensitive components in the dominant singular subspace of edited weights, enabling selective reversal of targeted knowledge edits while preserving unrelated edits.

Continual-learning pipeline with skill-conditioned credit assignment, hierarchical credit aggregation, and momentum-smoothed optimization evolves multi-agent skill libraries through refinement, induction, consolidation, and pruning.

READY qualification framework measures reliability-cost-oversight operating points for enterprise agent deployment, exposing 39.2% vs 29.6% human-review burdens hidden behind near-equal benchmark accuracy.
Database-native version control exposing Git-style snapshot/branch/diff/merge through SQL extensions keeps parallel agentic exploration of relational data isolated, reproducible, and auditable.
Rate-distortion framework treats quantization as lossy compression, recovering the VQ-PQ-SQ distortion hierarchy and connecting distortion minimization to the STE-induced gradient discrepancy.
MeanField surrogate predicts per-model GPU performance from local configuration and aggregate GPU state, scaling runtime scheduling of co-running models to N=5 with zero SLA violations.
Persistent discovery context stores prior intent-to-object mappings for reuse by data-centric agents and characterizes a reproducible memory-interference failure mode in lexically sparse domains.
Human-in-the-loop SOP Engineering converts expert GUI demonstrations into reusable, verified SOP skills with step-wise grounding and execution for professional computer-use agents.
Identifies fault points in multi-agent medical conversations where human interventions shift diagnostic accuracy by up to 40% or induce premature-closure-style diagnostic drift.

Aggregates local skills into de-instantiated procedural-family priors with a commit gate admitting a prior only when execution shows no library degradation, for self-improving agents on long-horizon task streams.

Estimates empirical state potentials from anchor-state-group return statistics to derive cross-trajectory step-level credit, differentiating actions within failed trajectories in multi-turn agentic RL.

Catalogs eleven failure modes of LLM-judge evaluation signals in autonomous prompt-optimization loops (cached answer keys, corrupted ground truth, silent parser fallback) and gates every change behind deterministic verification via PROCTOR.

Hierarchical trajectory-memory plus category-level procedural skills with GRPO-optimized distillation enable ground-truth-free test-time self-improvement via skill-guided RL with drift regularization.
Vector-quantized codebook plus reward-weighted MLP amortizes query-conditional multi-agent topology design after showing reward-filtered topologies collapse to about six distinct graphs.

Neural differential-equation belief tracker with multi-timescale memory ledger, uncertainty-triggered clarification, and counterfactual auditing separates genuine preference drift from adversarial memory poisoning.
Compiles paper-grounded evidence into repository-level implementation specifications with provenance and non-degradation constraints, cutting high-severity critiques in paper-to-code generation.

SGTM-trained suite of six 254M models with graded disentanglement shows the most disentangled models incur roughly 4x lower retain cost under unlearning, direct causal evidence that representational entanglement drives collateral damage.
Critique refinement and a deployment-imitating SWE-agent harness (DISH) make simulated alignment evaluations harder for target models to distinguish from real deployments.
Systems survey organizing GUI-agent efficiency into observation, context/memory, action, and runtime axes and synthesizing recurring mechanisms such as selective reading and recoverable memory.

AGENTSCOPE abstracts agent trajectories into structured representations with neural invariants so LLM-guided reasoning pinpoints failure step and type, beating LLM-judge diagnosis on Who&When and AgentErrata.
Procrustes alignment of per-layer router control subspaces reveals a shared canonical routing dynamics across MoE depth, with a single linear transition reaching R2 0.39-0.71.

Defines verifier information density V_d and shows terminal-reward credit targeting is the wrong axis in low-V_d agentic regimes, where uniformly spread dense reward beats concentrated credit on tau2-bench.
Logical validity is near-perfectly decodable from hidden states despite near-chance behavior, while interventions along probe-derived validity directions show only weak nonspecific causal effects.

Scalable Kronecker-Fisher approximation identifies value-projection layers as most sensitive and correlates with degradation under quantization and inter-layer corruption, guiding mixed-precision allocation.

MCP-mediated 300-plus-turn Civilization VI benchmark introduces Proactive Monitoring Rate and RAG@10 metrics, exposing under-monitoring of latent strategic state and unexecuted planning commitments in long-horizon agents.

Builds multi-layer multi-slot embeddings from decoder hidden states with hard-negative-aware slot specialization for text-video retrieval, an application of internal states rather than their analysis.

Couples a DDPG actor to the Met Office Unified Model via rank-local tensors for bounded bias correction, reducing forecast MAE 2-5% at 3.57% wall-time overhead; RL control of a physics model, not agent self-evolution.

Derives critical learning rates for Polyak and Nesterov momentum in power-law kernel regression, showing Polyak enlarges the critical batch size and yielding a three-regime batch-size stability phase diagram.

Declarative Attention lets models declare global/focus/local modes parsed like tool calls to skip most KV-cache reads, a throughput mechanism with modest accuracy loss and no reliability or precision angle.
DisCo distills 5,000+ verified skills from 1,000 widely used ML repositories into the AREX-Skill Library, lifting an autonomous research agent by 134.3% on MLE-bench and 34.4% on PaperBench.

Models orchestrator-worker reflection as a bilevel coordination game, proves transcript-only gates cannot beat text-indistinguishable environments, and derives SRMA memory updates grounded in evaluation-risk decrease.

Influence-guided response rewriting of IF-selected training examples produces stronger bidirectional behavioral shifts than reweighting the same examples, a training-data attribution intervention study.
EarlyEval trains LightGBM success and failure classifiers over behavioral and textual features to halt agent runs early, eliminating 13-26% of steps at 89-97% prediction accuracy.

Converts trajectory-level safety evidence into auditable, reversible harness updates while SFT-then-RL policy co-evolution shapes multi-step safety behavior, achieving a 3x attack-success-rate reduction.
Structured reasoning framework for telecom root cause analysis with canonical telemetry contexts and enforced decision-path reasoning; a domain application of LLM diagnosis.
GDB-Reward systematically transforms heterogeneous graphic-design evaluation metrics into a unified reinforcement learning reward, demonstrating non-differentiable metrics as optimization objectives.

Cliff uses an off-the-shelf teacher to locate the first mistake in each rollout and converts the correct-prefix/incorrect-suffix split into token-level advantages, beating GRPO by 7% across 12 scenarios.

Pairs E2M1 payloads with unsigned E5M3 block scales, selective stochastic rounding, and FP4 in all eligible linears for stable 190B-token FP4 pretraining, finishing below Transformer Engine NVFP4 loss with 21.2% higher throughput when RHT and BF16 exemptions are removed.
Introduces predicted-state matching so web-agent world models produce representations that discriminate alternative actions' outcomes, improving PRM-style ranking and WebArena-Lite success.

Interaction features between LoRA-adapted and base-LLM hidden states identify tokens of high semantic dependence for targeted correction in speech recognition, beating global rescoring and late fusion.

Identifies a direction of ignorance in the unembedding matrix encoding the unigram prior; its projection factorizes the prediction state into a tempered Bayesian update and is causally steerable across four model families.

ObserverBench separates estimation accuracy from action loss for mechanistic observers, showing AUROC ranks monitors differently from deployment loss and that sparse SAE readouts trail dense controls.
Tests activation-probe collusion monitoring under explicit monitor awareness and feedback: telling agents they are watched neither hides them nor stops collusion across two multi-agent games.
SHELF generates controlled bibliographic benchmark data from Library of Congress taxonomies for classification, clustering, and retrieval; a library-science evaluation harness.

DP-BR-FedAvg combines Gaussian differential privacy with trimmed-mean Byzantine-robust aggregation so compromised clients cannot steer the shared model; federated-learning robustness rather than LLM training observability.

Rank-k projection ablations on matrix-CODI latent reasoning are flat across four readouts and three seeds, showing the loss is rank-indifferent and matrix latents do not carry parallel reasoning paths via rank.

Time-encoded analog photonic interposer converts amplitudes to timing intervals over WDM links with implicit 6-bit time-domain quantization, achieving 2.04x energy-delay-product improvement over an 8-bit digital electrical baseline.

FPGA systolic Givens-QRD solver in single-precision floating point reaches 2.3x power-normalized throughput with RMSE 5.1e-7 against a MATLAB float32 reference; a validated DSP kernel, not an ML precision-reliability study.

Six-type taxonomy of contextual knowledge conflicts with mechanistic analysis showing latent conflict awareness, representational geometry of conflict processing, and a positional bias, plus a training-free activation-steering fix.

RACE-AIMC certifies an exact upper bound (mean 7.83%) on the error rate of physical analog in-memory accelerators distorted by programming errors, noise, and broken cells, with online accept-or-defer checks against a fallback.

Jaccard routing overlap and adapter-gradient cosine similarity show MoE+LoRA negative transfer stems from near-orthogonal domain gradients contending within one low-rank adapter subspace; SpawnLoRA adds gated sub-adapters on contention.

BASP partitions GPUs into batch-aware sequence-parallel groups to shrink all-to-all communication groups, delivering 1.17-1.31x end-to-end training speedup on an A100 cluster at identical accuracy and memory.
VeriPhy compiles prompts into typed physical obligations with provenance-carrying evidence records and typed resolvers, producing auditable three-valued verdicts on generated-video physics.
Jina-OCR-v1 combines DeepSeek-OCR components with FastMTP speculative decoding and GRPO under dense verifiable structural rewards; primarily an efficient OCR system release.
Proposes behavioral indicators, metrics, and thresholds for monitoring progression toward catastrophic AI outcomes; a policy framework without technical evaluation.
MemoryLACE models the lifecycle of textual evidence via sparse merge, supersession, and contradiction relations, reconstructing relation-aware evidence units that cut BEAM runtime by 66.6%.
SGD-KV uses a chunk-summarization diagnostic to identify aggregation-specialized attention heads and allocate KV budget by head, saving up to 75% cache memory; serving efficiency.
Speculative Macro Commit pre-executes drafter-predicted action chains on isolated environment snapshots and commits them when the actor agrees, cutting agent wall time 18-45%; a latency mechanism.

FlowBalance calibrates token-level self-guidance with verifier group advantage (retain, reverse, or disable) via trajectory balance, with an exact correction against false-positive self-guidance on rejected responses.
Documents Model-Issued Pseudo-Credentials: Qwen, Mistral, and Llama accept model-generated identity tests as proof of developer identity, a behavioral safety finding outside the infrastructure areas.
Traces six input perturbations through output behavior, hidden-state geometry (CKA, intrinsic dimension), and attention-head function, showing that single-metric robustness claims are misleading.

PlanFence has executors dependency-scope validation to the plan-cited records that can affect the pending action, eliminating the stale-plan execution that freshness-only executors commit in every controlled task.

GAR extracts per-rollout gradient vectors via truncated backprop through the output projection and scores cosine similarity to expert-anchor gradients as a dense RLVR reward with a multiplicative error/activation decomposition.
GPU-resident batched Levenberg-Marquardt solver with reverse-mode Jacobian assembly sustains 5.1e5 trees per second for symbolic regression constant optimization, roughly 9.9x Operon throughput.

RecurTrace adds Loop Memory Attention over prior loop iterations and an oracle-supervised halting head for adaptive latent recurrence depth; a reasoning architecture rather than an analysis of representations.

TIGPO maintains persistent per-task transition graphs across policy updates with Exploration and Revisit slots pairing current rollouts to earlier ones for stabilized cross-temporal advantage estimation.
Dude's granularity-aligned negotiation and two-stage salience filtering across dual detection agents curb over-interpretation in paper-code discrepancy detection, improving F1 by up to 18.7%.

Normalized compression distance residualized against a permutation control measures generative-process diversity across 38 language models and predicts correlated failure (partial rank association -0.216) beyond semantic similarity.
Lngram v2 decouples latent n-gram memory routes from backbone width with Sink and surrogate-gradient readouts; mostly an architecture contribution despite the interpretable discrete-ID analysis.

Answer-key-free protocol scores image-free object-token edits at the representation level of frozen VLMs, showing explicit edit teaching rather than ordinary VQA training produces edit responsiveness.

Random Attention evicts KV entries uniformly at random within heads yet matches the strongest scorer with 32-43% higher throughput, explained by prompt fragility and two-level trace redundancy; an efficiency finding.

CONFLICTGUI exposes execution-biased overcompliance of GUI agents under conflicting instructions; CONFLICTGUARD's feasibility verification and conditional action modulation restore conflict-aware termination.
OCR-EDR closes the loop from rendering-aware error diagnosis to executable edits and iterative reassessment, repairing 86.23% of erroneous OCR predictions to visual consistency.

Sixteen preregistered studies (179,352 attempts) measure how pointer versus criterion directives in inherited agent memory steer which archived record gets pulled, including gain-dependent defensive-adapter rules.
LOCOMO-CONV evaluates memory retrieval in situ across dialog, implicit, counterfactual, and composed query styles, exposing retrieval gaps and silent grounding missed by QA-style memory benchmarks.

Counterexample-guided conjecturing over 348k graphs with a 559-relation novelty filter and counterexample search yields 6,522 surviving graph-theory conjectures plus Lean 4 formalization, an automated scientific-discovery pipeline.
NTEP-R rewards alignment of pre-call intent and post-call summarization with necessary tool-evidence paths and penalizes redundant calls, supervising evidence acquisition in agentic VLMs.

GrowPage treats KV capacity as a runtime resource with dual-timescale query summaries estimating demand evolution, acquiring or compressing pages under PagedAttention; serving-memory efficiency without a reliability or precision angle.

Constrained reordering and active-passive transformations of GSM8K degrade multilingual reasoning; residual-stream activation patching localizes entity-quantity alignment failures to intermediate layers.

Shows exponential-moving-average temporal aggregation makes scorer modifications indistinguishable under aggressive KV eviction; InertiaKV-Lazy yields 1.34-1.46x decode throughput, a serving-efficiency analysis.
Piecewise truncated gradient formulation counters gradient vanishing for distant Gaussians in 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization; graphics training, not large-model training observability.

Dalek re-derives von Neumann's self-reproducing automaton for a text-and-message agent substrate so an LLM plus compiler payload authors, installs, and inherits its own capabilities, closing heredity and evolution within the machine.

HalluPeer provides aligned paper, human-review, and hallucination-injected-review triples with a peer-review-specific taxonomy, showing existing detectors cannot separate hallucinations from legitimate critique.
Google technical report for WeatherNext 3: hourly 0.1-degree probabilistic forecasts trained on raw satellite and station observations rather than analysis data.
KC-Bench's 238 interactive tasks with stateful tools and deterministic assertions show no model reliably resolves knowledge conflicts, which propagate into tool calls and protected-data flows.
RASER extends Slurm with work-stealing agentic job arrays, user-space checkpointing via requeue, and Apptainer isolation, cutting makespan by 39% while tolerating preemption and failures.

Systematically shows structured compression degrades test-time adaptation under distribution shift due to reduced representational diversity, with effects strongly dependent on the compression method.
R2-MAD accumulates experience memory from past debates; debate-state-aware retrieval calibrates concept priors and derives per-agent confidence weights to counter shared misconceptions.
Typed research objects, capability-bound operations, and a compositional workflow algebra bind agent reasoning to verified physical laboratory operations in a modular agentic robotic lab.
Partitioned Convolutional SAE decomposes spatiotemporal DiT activations into monosemantic features, and contrastive attribution isolates concept kernels for timestep-resolved surgical erasure.

Shows injected end-of-think tokens fail to induce the answering phase (spurious CoT termination) due to insufficient attention, which Exit-token Attention Biasing reduces across four LRMs and five benchmarks.

RAED selects experiments by the smallest expected structural candidate set under false-exclusion control and proves an exact aliasing separation from expected information gain on subsurface-flow and methane benchmarks.
Causal interventions identify attention heads that represent coreference, form plural references, and transfer entity information for pronoun prediction, plus human-aligned pluralization preferences.
Shows a single-agent harness with execution-feedback repair matches multi-agent CAE simulation systems (FoamBench 96.4% vs 88.2%), with solver-tutorial domain knowledge the largest remaining gain.
SimSkill identifies capability gaps, self-generates and verifies environment-grounded SUMO tasks, and consolidates experience into episodic, procedural, and semantic memory for a self-evolving agent.
DNative-Twin records agentic decisions as typed trajectories and replays the decision mechanism in isolation; verification evidence raises unresolved-divergence recall from 0 to 1.0.
WAND is an explainable-by-design tabular anomaly detector whose witness directions give free per-feature attribution; general anomaly detection rather than training-run monitoring.

Characterizes attention training dynamics via trace order parameters and truncated matrix-moment hierarchies, showing tied attention induces automatic symmetry breaking with Theta(d^2 log d) weak recovery.
Xiaomi technical report for TabLDM, an SCM-synthetic-pretrained tabular foundation model with sparse MoE and test-time scaling, ranked first on OpenML-CTR23.
HookPry exploits the blindly trusted lifecycle-hook update path to bind attacker commands to benign runtime events, compromising all seven evaluated agent harnesses at up to 92.5% success.

Compares SFT, reasoning-augmented fine-tuning, and ORPO across three model families, finding training method reshapes refusal circuits and no method avoids fragile concentration, capability cost, and uncorrectability simultaneously.
RuleMem induces natural-language Horn clauses validated by Rule Perplexity Consistency to actively guide retrieval and reasoning, exceeding the 14-baseline average by 27.47 points on LoCoMo.
Position paper proposing value-preserving MAS architecture patterns (federated topology for privacy, distributed pluralism, guard-agent fairness) without empirical evaluation.
Headroom-Drift Replay separates GRPO replay into remaining-learning-value ranking and policy-drift gating, a sample-efficiency primitive for RL post-training.
EquiReview-R recasts AI peer review as evidence-guided refinement of a structured concern set, reducing major overcritique from 15.5% to 8.1% under prespecified non-inferiority criteria.

Shows serving-adapter interface mismatch silently censors well-formed tool calls, flipping BFCL scores from 0.00 to 0.96 and zeroing verl AgentLoop acceptance, invalidating agent evaluations and training loops.

Uno augments autoregressive LLMs with lightweight diffusion weights and lossless Psi-Spec samplers for up to 3x throughput; a speed method whose lossless property is a design goal, not a reliability study.

Representational similarity optimization aligns latent moral categorization with human prototype structure, improving adversarial robustness where response-level alignment leaves categorization unchanged.

Traces video-diffusion QAT detail loss to timestep-agnostic pipelines; denoising-stage-oriented supervision and disabling CFG in final steps prevent quantization errors from amplifying into high-frequency artifacts under W4A4 and W3 settings.

Identifies spurious advantage in GRPO when rollouts guess correct answers in bounded-answer or search settings; SIGNBALANCE restores composition-free, zero-mean magnitudes via stop-gradient per-class rescaling.

LaPla uses a residual VQ-VAE latent as a physical prior and decodes continuous latents to avoid codebook quantization error in driving trajectory generation; an autonomous-driving planner, not a precision-reliability study.

PatchBench detects memorized patches (25% substantial similarity to historical fixes) and stack-trace-only crash suppression, validating vulnerability-patching agents on transplanted vulnerabilities with security and semantic checks.

DRACO dynamically generates rubrics during training and redistributes per-trajectory judgment closed-form over responsible steps for GRPO advantages, gaining 15.9 points on AppWorld without any verifiers.

Minima runs NVFP4 W4A4 on all 496 linear layers including Gated DeltaNet's recurrence, matching BF16 within seed noise, and explains why via 16-element block-scaled outlier localization, gate error compression to 2% output error, and a flat noise plateau over 32K tokens.

Direct-P maps attention scores directly to FP4 probabilities for up to 2.13x BF16 forward throughput on GB200; FP8 gradient operands stabilize backward while every tested MXFP4 probability/value training trajectory diverges.
Shows two-stage OPD-then-RL beats joint fusion of dense distillation and RLVR signals via pass@k and learning-dynamics analysis; a post-training recipe study rather than stability or observability.

Evolves terminal-environment difficulty off-policy along three directions derived from the multi-turn learning objective, providing continuous learning signals worth 14.4 and 18.0 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1.
Presents NLIP, an Ecma-standardized application-layer protocol with semantic message envelopes for agent interoperability; standardization infrastructure without evaluation against the areas.
Terminal-Universe replays recorded file operations to reconstruct workspaces from existing trajectories and synthesizes breadth- and depth-scaled verifiable tasks for terminal-agent post-training.
SENTINEL-RL offloads topological reasoning to a graph attention encoder plus PPO policy, restricting the LLM to narrating gated recommendations; an applied SOC pipeline.
Causal taxonomy separates deceptive-looking behavior from deceptive mechanisms; guessing-game and stock-trading interventions show recipient information state causally affects deceptive preference.

SWE-Gate adds real pull-request review constraints as separate tests, showing 221 of 644 functionally passing repairs violate review constraints, so functional-only evaluation overestimates coding agents.

Para-Pipe integrates intra- and inter-stage operator parallelism within pipelined execution across SoC processing units, producing Pareto-optimal throughput-latency configurations on two heterogeneous SoCs.

Case study of a 100-agent autonomous research swarm where an evaluation exploit spontaneously emerged and spread via shared library and peer messages, triggering emergent auditing, boycotts, formal complaints, and validation patches.
One-query on-policy distillation recovers most full-data gains; state-coverage analysis shows OPD is data-overfed but algorithm-starved, a distillation data-efficiency study.

Controlled pre-training experiments show reallocating repetition tokens to auxiliary reformulated views improves knowledge acquisition even for factual recall, a pre-training data composition finding.

Operationalizes CoT step importance as advantage via Monte Carlo rollouts; LLM judges and fine-tuned critics identify high-advantage steps far short of the noise ceiling, cautioning process reward modeling.
ESPO's Diagnose-Propose-Select phases with bootstrap stability selection counter evolutionary prompt bloat, beating GEPA by 3.76pp with 47% shorter prompts.

Preregistered audits of 52,988 requests show black-box LLM judges on shared endpoints fail measurement-reliability thresholds (Spearman 0.400 same-window versus required 0.90), with byte-identical next-day replays disagreeing across providers.
S3T uses denser temporal sampling as a privileged teacher for self-distilled video state tracking; self-supervised training rather than agent self-evolution.
Hardware-conscious software training recovers DNN inference accuracy degraded by manufacturing-induced hardware variations in accelerator chips.

Distills floating-cache behavior into low-rank Q/K/V projection adapters on a fixed quantizer, recovering 54-76% of the 4-bit KV-cache perplexity gap while showing perplexity recovery need not restore long-context retrieval.
ProToMEx uses probabilistic topic models for global and local classifier explanations 30-40x faster than SHAP/LIME on tabular data; classical ML explainability, not LLM internals.
FDSOI time-domain analog softmax circuit converts CIM score voltages to exponential weights via a shared ramp and RC decay without ADC conversion, with ramp/RC-programmable effective temperature.

Varying reviewer capability in execute-review-revise pipelines shows same-model self-review has the highest detection recall yet no net gain, falsely rejecting 35% of correct answers via revision inertia.

Failure-aware SAE training yields interpretable latent directions that outperform confidence-based failure prediction in VLMs and reveal a shift from class-specific to ambiguous or style-related concepts at failure.
FailureSpot builds action-derived weak supervision (inconsistent, frozen, or aggressive action chunks) plus active learning for label-efficient timestamp-level VLA failure localization.
NSA-Bench formalizes nano self-assembly prediction with the multimodal NSA-Net reaching 0.949 ROC-AUC; a domain-specific ML benchmark for nanomedicine.
EvoHarnessBench places non-stationarity in the agent harness itself across 17 multi-stage streams, exposing harness-induced forgetting and inconsistent gains from self-evolving adaptation.
Short analysis arguing data movement rather than compute dominates energy on Huawei's tau folded-silicon chip, defusing thermal-scaling objections; no evaluation methodology.
llmovoice middleware models paralinguistic and environmental voice context with runtime directives, cutting false interruptions from 46.0% to 0.9%; voice-serving systems work.

Ports 80+ agentic benchmarks through validated adapters, evaluates 8 models across 54 benchmarks, and curates Harbor-Index's 82 audited tasks where no model-harness configuration exceeds 30% pass rate.
Zero-shot LLM pipeline discovers continuous strategic features and k-means abstraction buckets for imperfect-information games, cutting exploitability up to 62% on HUNL endgames.

Reverse-constructs multi-hop search tasks from hyperlink graphs with entity-reference rewriting and trains via alternating SFT-RL climbing that recycles the hardest solved rollouts into supervised passes.
MedProb probes frozen VLM representations linearly for medical VQA, recovering more answer-relevant signal than prompting and shrinking the small-versus-large model gap.
